objective: Resincronizar exclusivamente Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos de CIENFUEGOS para agosto 2026 usando la extracción SoftRestaurant R54 que convierte pagos con el tipo de cambio histórico de chequespagos. No modificar Sync_Sales, Resumen de Cuentas, Comandas de Venta, Ventas por Periodo, Formas de Pago (Corte), MPRO ni Produccion. Certificar que Pagos por Ticket concilie con $3,959,563.00 y que folios 104124 y 104623 queden en $3,565.00 y $470.00 respectivamente.

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_payments_certification
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS filas_pago, COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets_con_pago, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS pagos_total, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Propina),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina_total FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_gap_tickets_after_resync
queries.sql: SELECT NumeroTicket AS folio, CAST(SUM(ISNULL(Importe,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS total_pago, COUNT(*) AS filas_pago FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND NumeroTicket IN ('104124','104623') AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY NumeroTicket ORDER BY NumeroTicket

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_payment_vs_sales_reference
queries.sql: WITH ventas AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT numero_ticket) AS tickets_venta, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(importe_neto),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS venta_total FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1), pagos AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets_pago, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS pagos_total FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1) SELECT v.tickets_venta, v.venta_total, p.tickets_pago, p.pagos_total, CAST(v.venta_total-p.pagos_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS diferencia FROM ventas v CROSS JOIN pagos p

queries.name: cienfuegos_aug26_expected_totals_gate
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ABS(CAST(ISNULL(SUM(Importe),0) AS decimal(18,2))-CAST(3959563.00 AS decimal(18,2)))<=0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pagos_total_ok, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket)=1027 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tickets_ok FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='CIENFUEGOS' AND FechaHora>='2026-08-01' AND FechaHora<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1
